profile.headline: Ph.D. | Simulation and Automation Engineer
profile.summary:
Simulation software engineer with a Ph.D. in Mechanical Engineering. Experienced in C++, Python, and MATLAB.

Prior to working in defense, I worked on connected & automated vehicles and fuel efficiency technologies for about 10 years, co-authoring 11 publications and 1 patent.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed high-fidelity simulations and internal tools supporting teams across Lockheed Martin Space.

Simulation Development & Support:
- Built and maintained C++20 models with comprehensive unit tests
- Developed Python 3 integration tests and APIs
- Ported legacy simulation components to modern codebases
- Acted as liaison with internal sim users for feature development and debugging
Python Automation & Scientific Computing:
- Automated .proto file generation for cross-model message-passing
- Automated requirement tagging in Word
- Implemented satellite self-shadowing using NumPy and 3D geometry
- Refactored numerical algorithms with SciPy sparse matrices to reduce memory footprint
Strategic Proposal Contribution – $2.3B Win:
- Modernized legacy C++ code used in proposal feasibility study
- Wrapped autogenerated Simulink C++ for simulation integration
Agile Development & Collaboration:
- Participated in quarterly planning and 2-week sprints
- Used Jira for task tracking and backlog grooming
- Collaborated on architecture and system requirements (Confluence, draw.io)
- Conducted code reviews and CI through GitLab

positions.title: Mid-level Simulation Software Engineer
positions.description:
6DOF missile simulation development:
-Run Monte Carlo simulations
-Optimize C++/Fortran code: Led to 20% reduction in sim running time
-Develop C++11  interface for 3rd-party data & applications
-Perform large Git branch merges
-Automate data processing pipeline using Bash/Matlab
-Customize compilation using CMake

company.name: College of Engineering - Center for Environmental Research and Technology

positions.title: Assistant Specialist
positions.description:
R&D of fuel-saving Connected Vehicle application (Eco Approach and Departure for Actuated Signals):
-Use MATLAB for single-vehicle simulation and data analysis
-Code simulated application in C++
-Conduct sensitivity analysis of application in traffic simulation (PTV VISSIM)
40-driver study of prototype Honda driver feedback technology

positions.title: Graduate Student Researcher
positions.description:
- Develop 2 Automated Vehicle applications in C++, which reduce accident likelihood by 15-40% at lane-change and merging areas (in simulation)
- Develop 3 other simulated technologies in Python/C++ (vehicle radar, High Speed Differential Warning, Eco Approach and Departure at Signalized Intersections)
- Develop Python application utilizing DSRC (Dedicated Short-Range Communications) radios to remotely monitor a vehicle's speed
- Design & conduct on-road experiments investigating low-cost methods of boosting GPS/GNSS accuracy by up to 80%
- Code/calibrate large, detailed traffic networks in PTV VISSIM (17-mile highway section, arterial network with 20+ intersections...)
Publications/Presentations:
- Co-author 6 papers (5 first-author) and numerous reports
- Present at 3 international conferences

positions.title: Undergraduate Researcher
positions.description:
4-year Nissan project:
•	Oversaw & conducted on-road experiments of driver assistance technologies, including data collection and equipment maintenance
•	Performed data analysis in MATLAB and presented results regularly to Nissan
Co-authored 2 papers and several reports
Compiled list of feasible ITS technologies for use by Riverside Transit Agency

positions.title: Director of Research & Development
positions.description:
•	Designed, fabricated, and investigated failure modes of prototype soccer ball launcher (3 iterations)
•	Developed MATLAB simulation of soccer ball flight, utilizing latest research on soccer ball physics
•	Used computer programming together with CAD to determine feasible ranges for part dimensions
•	Supervised interns
